faq.question: Q1. What is Samagra Shiksha Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment notification issued by Samagra Shiksha Assam for 68 positions of Additional Resource Person, Assistant Additional Resource Person, and Special Educator.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 68 vacancies are available, comprising 23 for ARP, 34 for AARP, and 11 for Special Educator.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 62 years of age as on 01-01-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Special Educator?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University with Special B.Ed. or a one-year diploma in Special Education with a valid RCI CRR number, along with minimum 5 years working experience.
